description: change-history.md states change history is available 'when Magma storage is used for a bucket' and never states the converse - that Couchstore buckets cannot have it. No enablement path is offered for Couchstore, and Couchstore is the only other storage engine, so the exclusivity is real but only implied. A reader on a Couchstore bucket is left to infer that the feature is unavailable rather than being told.
